links.outcome: Prospective silent-deployment F1 versus retrospective F1 for irAE detection
links.effect: Retrospective macro-averaged F1 0.92 for current-event detection; prospective silent deployment over 3 months binary F1 0.72-0.79.

links.outcome: Staff annotation time, accuracy, agreement with versus without agentic assistance
links.effect: Assistance reduced annotation time by 2.71 min (P < 0.001), increased complete-match accuracy (OR 1.45; 95% CI 1.01-2.08), Krippendorff's α from 0.22-0.51 to 0.82-0.85.
links.quote: In a randomized crossover study of clinical trial staff, agentic assistance reduced annotation time by 2.71 min (P < 0.001), increased complete-match accuracy (odds ratio 1.45; 95% confidence interval 1.01-2.08; P = 0.045) and improved interannotator agreement (Krippendorff's α from 0.22-0.51 to 0.82-0.85).
